meta.title: Add interactive chart for gh-pages site with Chart.js and toggle controls
meta.body_summary: Replace static chart image on gh-pages with interactive Chart.js chart, adding agent toggles, view modes, and JSON data export for improved performance and interactivity.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot replaced static PNG with Chart.js interactive chart; merged after maintainer refined UI and added data; no human review blocking.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 2344 changed lines across 8 files, this is a medium-to-large frontend enhancement. It represents a substantial feature addition that merged after maintainer polish without review friction.

review_details.concern_detail: Bot review flagged potential runtime errors (missing Path import, invalid dt.UTC), lack of tests, and stylistic issues, but none were blocking.
review_details.performance_claim: JSON data is only 8KB (vs 612KB PNG), Chart.js loaded via CDN for optimal performance, resulting in a fast and lightweight interactive chart.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Copilot successfully integrated Chart.js with backend JSON export, toggles, and responsive design; merged after maintainer UI polish. The agent missed some imports and tests but no blocking issues.

detection_detail.code_reading: Bot review flagged missing Path import and incorrect dt.UTC; maintainer later refined code in 'nicer interactive chart and table' commit.
detection_detail.manual_test: Maintainer committed chart data updates and UI improvements, indicating manual testing and refinement.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR includes local development instructions, but performance numbers (8KB vs 612KB) were narrative and not measured in a controlled manner.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: Bot-identified issues like missing Path import and lack of tests were not addressed by Copilot; maintainer improved code in follow-up commits before merge.

core_change_summary.description: Added Chart.js interactive chart to docs/index.html with agent toggle controls and JSON data export via generate_chart.py; updated CSS for responsive chart controls.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: collect_data.py and data.csv were updated for data collection; README stats refreshed; binary chart.png unchanged in content.
change_trajectory: Copilot added interactive chart with Chart.js and JSON data.
Enhanced with advanced controls and tooltips.
Maintainer made extensive refinements in 'nicer interactive chart and table' commit.
Merge from main and data update.

review_signals.summary: Bot reviewed 8/8 files, generated no comments, but suppressed 6 low-confidence issues including missing imports, test coverage, and coding style.

collaboration_trajectory: Copilot opened PR linked to issue with interactive chart implementation.
Bot review posted about 23.5 hours later with low-confidence issues but no blocking comments.
Maintainer added 'nicer interactive chart and table' commit with significant UI improvements, then merged after final data update.
